snippet.title: TerraScape Ancient Egypt (DLC) Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out 𝐀𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3868750⁣
⁣
𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐚𝐒𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐞 𝐀𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭: Build a thriving desert city along the Nile! Strategically place buildings to create synergies and turn barren desert into fertile Nile land. Create complexes and construct impressive monuments while adapting to the changing seasons and harnessing the Nile’s floods as your settlement grows into a legendary empire.⁣
